Department of Education
About the Department
The Education Department at Tyagbir Hem Baruah College is dedicated to preparing future educators and professionals in the field of education. The department offers a range of courses that cover various aspects of education, including theory, practice, and research. Located in the culturally rich region of Assam, India, the department is committed to providing students with a holistic education that emphasizes both academic excellence and practical skills development.The faculty members of the Education Department are highly qualified and experienced educators who are passionate about teaching and learning. They are experts in their respective fields, with many actively engaged in research and publication. The faculty members bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the classroom, ensuring that students receive a high-quality education that is relevant and up-to-date.The curriculum of the Education Department is designed to be comprehensive and rigorous, covering a wide range of topics in education. Students are exposed to various theories and approaches to education, as well as practical skills such as lesson planning, classroom management, and assessment. The department also offers courses that focus on specific areas of education, such as educational psychology, curriculum development, and educational technology.

Vision
The vision of the Education Department at Tyagbir Hem Baruah College is to be a premier center for excellence in teacher education, known for its innovative practices, research-driven curriculum, and commitment to holistic development. The department envisions producing educators who are reflective practitioners, equipped with the knowledge, skills, and values to meet the diverse needs of learners in the 21st century.
Mission
The mission of the Education Department at Tyagbir Hem Baruah College is to prepare competent, compassionate, and socially responsible educators who are committed to excellence in teaching and learning. The department aims to provide a rigorous and comprehensive education that combines theoretical knowledge with practical skills. Through innovative pedagogy, research, and community engagement, the department seeks to foster a deep understanding of educational principles and practices.
Departmental Library
The Departmental Library of the Education Department at Tyagbir Hem Baruah College is a valuable resource for students and faculty, offering a diverse collection of books, journals, and multimedia materials related to education. It serves as a hub for research, study, and professional development, supporting the academic mission of the department.
